purpose: ONS Family Spending, financial year ending 2025 (workbook 1, Table 3.1E, released 11 June 2026), UK private households from the Living Costs and Food Survey: mean weekly household expenditure on each COICOP division and on the twelve together, by equivalised disposable income decile group on the updated OECD-modified scale (2-adult reference), and for all households. The official reference the lcfs_consumption decile_fit receipt sets beside its frame-against-donor comparison (microcosm#1717, PolicyEngine/chronicle#446). ONS suppresses Education in every decile, so those cells have no row.
policy: Rows are copied verbatim from the pinned Chronicle consumer feed named in source_fact_feed; every value is a publisher-stated fact. Consumers declare their own arithmetic on these rows and never edit this file by hand: regenerate it with tools/vendor_uk_ledger_facts.py.

attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (Family spending workbook 1: detailed expenditure and trends, financial year ending 2025).
